description: Reviewed HTTP wire types. Arrays flatten without numeric indexes as observed by AppGW CRS 3.2. Model identifiers are resolved only from canonical API definitions; they are never WAF tuning inputs.

codex.notes: Public source compatibility, not proof of the installed Desktop build or Foundry acceptance.

openai.notes: Azure exposes a provider subset. WAF wire compatibility does not enable new application features.

flux.notes: Official named image slots 1 through 8. Azure flex advertises 10 images; wire names for 9/10 not confirmed and not guessed.

gateway.version: repository source; checked by operation signature
gateway.notes: The HTTP input at the WAF boundary, not downstream payloads synthesized by APIM/BFF.

notes: Protocol/CVE individual exceptions below are grandfathered explicitly, not broadened by semantic type.
Media URL fields are model content references. Actual fetch/control URL fields remain controls; excluding them requires a separate review.
HTTP payload compatibility does not change provider acceptance, schema validation, size, MIME, query, authentication, signature or WSS checks.
